test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution required’.**

None of the soldiers __did not survive__ when trapped in the glacier.
solution:
The correct answer is: **could survive**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is written in the simple past tense.
 
• "**None of the**" is already mentioned in the sentence, so we cannot use two negative quantifiers in the same sentence.
 
• "**had not survived**" is used in the past perfect tense.
 
• "**survives**" is used in the present tense when the subject refers to the third person singular.
 
• Therefore, "**could survive**" is the only option that should be used.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Corrected sentence:** *None of the soldiers **could survive__** when trapped in the glacier.*
